notes:
Lead: Aurora Product Labs — mid-market B2B SaaS (product analytics + in-app orchestration). Primary champion: VP Product (Maria Reyes). Technical lead/CTO: Daniel Cho. Use case: replace current vendor for in-app chat assistant and execute tool-calls (calendar, billing lookup, code snippets) via agent flows. Key ask: p50 streaming latency <= 150ms and p95 <= 400ms under realistic concurrency (250 concurrent chat sessions).

POC plan: start with Hosted API to validate latency and streaming behavior. Two-week perf-focused POC: synthetic perf scripts + subset of production traffic replay (anonymized). If SLOs met, follow-up to scope Dedicated (reserved GPU) for predictable throughput and VPC. Pricing: wants both usage-based Hosted estimate and committed Dedicated cost model for budgeting.

Security / compliance: they are mid-market with regulated customers. Requirements called out by security team:
- SSO/SAML integration for admin console + audit trails (must integrate with Okta).
- SOC2 type II evidence required before procurement.
- Log retention policy: default 90 days, must be configurable; ability to disable logging for specific API routes that handle PII.
- PII redaction: token-level or field-level redaction (e.g., email, phone, ssn) before persistence in logs. They asked: "Can Redwood redact at ingestion so redacted content never touches persistent logs?"

Notes from recent calls: "We need guarantees on streaming latency — users notice lag at ~200ms." — VP Product.  "Security will not sign off if we can't turn off logs for specific routes or if PII can appear in system logs." — CTO.

Current status: evaluation. POC scheduled; SE to provide perf script and sample telemetry hooks. Security team reviewing SOC2 package and SSO instructions. Next meeting to align on POC success criteria and Dedicated sizing if passes.
